scope: One fictional, local, offline Seed Library qualification; no real artifact selection or owner consent is inferred from fixture data.
request: Use the actual native Theme Factory skill and its Botanical Garden definition for the three synthetic selection states in source-notes.json.
steps: Read the actual native catalog-selected theme-factory/SKILL.md and themes/botanical-garden.md. Both reads must appear in the actual tool trace. Preserve the original theme-showcase.pdf and all source bytes.

Read source-notes.json. Its selected case explicitly supplies the fictional owner's prior showcase presentation and Botanical Garden choice. This does not authorize native exposure, retention or modification of any real user's artifact.

Write botanical.html as one compact, self-contained Seed Library handout. Include the exact supplied heading, tagline and three seed names. Use all four Botanical Garden colors as swatches, --background, --text, --heading and --accent variables exactly as supplied, and readable body text; the orange accent is not body text. Set body background/color from those variables and use a heading at least24px. No JavaScript, images, network or external resources.

Use @font-face with ThemeHeaders mapped to fonts/DejaVuSerif-Bold.ttf and ThemeBody mapped to fonts/DejaVuSans.ttf. Use ThemeHeaders for headings and ThemeBody for body text. These private inputs and their full bundled license are seeded by the parent; do not download, edit or install any font.

For the separate unselected request, write awaiting-selection.md in at most90 words. Offer a Markdown file link to the unchanged actual canonical theme-showcase.pdf, ask which theme to use, and explicitly wait for selection. Create no unselected.html or other artifact.

For the unreviewed custom request, write custom-theme.json with exactly name, colors, fonts, applied and review_required. Use name Seed Workshop, colors with background/text/accent hex strings, and fonts with headers/body strings. Choose blue/cream roles with normal-text contrast at least4.5:1; set applied:false and review_required:true. Propose for review only; do not apply it to botanical.html.

Write worker-notes.md in at most160 words identifying the two actual source reads and the distinct selected/unselected/custom-review decisions. Do not claim serving-model identity, full native acceptance, retention or migration completion.

Write only the four output files in the supplied private fixture root, each mode0600. Preserve fixture-owner.json, source-notes.json and fonts/. Do not modify operation records, source/config/links, other clients, actual repositories or other roots.

No nested workers, browser/app launches, network, downloads, connectors, services, work/Affirm or protected-component access. The parent must roll back the exact temporary link after every outcome before checking the saved artifact locally.
